tradition_assertions.notes: Reviewed work/title crosswalk: the Church's numbered list names Habakkuk; TAU's index uses the Latinized form Habacuc and its book page identifies the Ethiopic Book of Habakkuk. This matches the work title only; the historical witness, current edition identity, numbering equivalence, transcription accuracy, and completeness remain unverified. British Library Add MS 16189's catalog lists the Twelve Prophets in this Ge'ez codex at folios 42v–64v and names a starting folio for each. This is manuscript-catalog evidence only; it does not verify a transcription, complete book boundaries, or identity with a particular current Church edition. Standard USFM title-candidate research readers are catalogued for Habakkuk.

witness.shelfmark_or_edition_id: Habakkuk section of Löfgren's seven-prophet edition
witness.editorial_policy: TAU says Löfgren's edition was based on Oxford MS Huntington 625 and other manuscripts, and that Kefela Ghebre prepared this text with permission and Ran HaCohen proofread it. The local capture retains three chapter pages and their linked source labels. Print collation, source manuscript inventory, and apparatus are not bundled.

agents.name: Ran HaCohen

coverage.structure_description: Three captured TAU text pages, corresponding to chapters 1–3 in its index, have sequential displayed linked numbers with extents 17, 20, and 19 (56 total). The chapter-2 links target Nahum, an unresolved source-page anomaly. This is complete only for the three locally retained text pages; no printed-edition or manuscript completeness is claimed.
coverage.supplements_and_editorial_signs: HTML whitespace and the separately displayed link labels are normalized; source markers and each link's actual book target remain separate, and visible Ethiopic text and signs are retained. Chapter 2's hyperlinks target Nahum; that anomaly is not silently corrected. Raw HTML is retained. Facsimiles and critical apparatus are excluded.
coverage.numbering_policy: Preserve source page and displayed linked-number sequence exactly: chapter pages 1–3, labels 1–17, 1–20, and 1–19. Preserve the actual link target book per unit (Hab, Nah, Hab). Do not infer alignment to another witness's numbering.
